common_instruction: First run the default operations/orchestration/resolve.mjs against fresh canonical main. Resolve the current closure index and hash-bound checkpoint before any historical pilot/preproduction record. If next_action.code is NONE, exit silently: do not replay Batch01/02 production or open another batch. Explicit evidence-envelope evaluation is not current-state discovery or execution authority. Read current canonical main in ${repository}, starting at docs/content-pipeline/registry/pipeline.json, official-1000-production-authority.json, batch-02-watcher-pilot.json and indexed current artifact hashes. Do not depend on prior chat history. Hard scope: official Mặn reserved 1000 lessons only. Act only as ${lane} on explicit current canonical work for that lane. Use operations/orchestration/resolve.mjs and existing versioned lane specification/contract evidence; if private required inputs are inaccessible, report exact capability/input gap, never infer a PASS. Reuse existing PASS gates and immutable assets, never override other lanes or process L5/Owner decisions. No action or already PASS receipt: end silently. Exceptions: record correct lane route; preserve independent siblings. Before mutation re-read canonical revision and reconcile receipt/branch/blob/deployment truth. Use reviewed scoped PR transitions with version/hash-bound receipts; re-resolve after a canonical transition. No Batch02 production while pilot is not approved by observed capability evidence and all preproduction gates. Audio only within standing prepaid authority with verified remaining budget and conservative reserved cost; insufficient funds stops paid audio branch only and routes OWNER_FUNDING_REQUIRED with minimum reasonable top-up. No top-up, increased limits, provider/billing change or unrelated expense. Do not add a scheduler/framework. Notify Owner only genuine exception/L5/funding or material pilot result; do not ask Owner to carry ordinary prompts.
